Build clean, exit 0. Two real bugs from bump, both fixed:

- `src/core/options.js` — read `options.retries` (old shape), new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed field name.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict check threw on `undefined`, new config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats undefined as disabled.

Remaining 8 warnings all deprecation noise (Buffer(), fs.exists, punycode etc) — not blocking, safe to ignore for now.
